set-variable.doc:name: Documents and metadata

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- (payload.embeddings zip vars.chunks) map ((pair, idx) -> { source_file: vars.currentDoc.file, domain: vars.currentDoc.domain, document_type: vars.currentDoc.documentType, version: vars.currentDoc.version, chunk_index: idx, chunk_text: pair[1], embedding: "[" ++ (pair[0] joinBy ",") ++ "]" })

db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Insert chunks + vectors
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO rag_chunks (source_file, domain, document_type, version, chunk_index, chunk_text, embedding) VALUES (:source_file, :domain, :document_type, :version, :chunk_index, :chunk_text, CAST(:embedding AS vector))

db:select.doc:name: Count stored chunks
db:select.db:sql: SELECT source_file, count(*) AS chunks FROM rag_chunks GROUP BY source_file ORDER BY source_file

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { chunkSize: vars.chunkSize, overlap: vars.overlap, totalChunks: sum(payload.chunks map ($ as Number)), perFile: payload }

db:select.doc:name: Similarity search
db:select.db:sql: SELECT source_file, domain, document_type, version, chunk_index, chunk_text, 1 - (embedding <=> CAST(:qvec AS vector)) AS score FROM rag_chunks WHERE (CAST(:domain AS varchar) IS NULL OR domain = CAST(:domain AS varchar)) AND (CAST(:documentType AS varchar) IS NULL OR document_type = CAST(:documentType AS varchar)) AND (CAST(:version AS varchar) IS NULL OR version = CAST(:version AS varchar)) ORDER BY embedding <=> CAST(:qvec AS vector) LIMIT :topK
db:select.db:input-parameters: #[{ qvec: vars.qvec, topK: vars.topK, domain: vars.filterDomain, documentType: vars.filterDocType, version: vars.filterVersion }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload map ((row) -> { source: row.source_file, domain: row.domain, documentType: row.document_type, version: row.version, chunkIndex: row.chunk_index, score: row.score, text: row.chunk_text })

http:request.doc:name: Generate answer with Groq

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { question: vars.question, topK: vars.topK, filters: { domain: vars.filterDomain, documentType: vars.filterDocType, version: vars.filterVersion }, minScore: vars.minScore, topScore: vars.topScore, grounded: true, answer: payload.choices[0].message.content, source: vars.retrievedChunks[0].source, retrievedChunks: vars.retrievedChunks }

on-error-continue.doc:name: Groq unreachable: degrade gracefully
on-error-continue.type: HTTP:CONNECTIVITY, HTTP:TIMEOUT, HTTP:UNAUTHORIZED, HTTP:FORBIDDEN, HTTP:TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, HTTP:SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { question: vars.question, topK: vars.topK, filters: { domain: vars.filterDomain, documentType: vars.filterDocType, version: vars.filterVersion }, minScore: vars.minScore, topScore: vars.topScore, grounded: false, degraded: true, answer: null, reason: "AI service unavailable or rate-limited", message: "Groq is unavailable or rate-limited right now. Showing the most relevant policy section instead.", excerpt: vars.retrievedChunks[0].text, source: vars.retrievedChunks[0].source, retrievedChunks: vars.retrievedChunks }
